full_judgment: 2. The land sought to be pre-empted appertains to khatian No. 78. The same originally belonged to Najemuddin Akhand and Faijuddin Akhariel and was ultimately acquired by auction-purchase pursuant to a mortgage-decree obtained by the father of the pre-emptors and opposite-party No. 3. The opposite party No. 3 Harendra Chandra Roy, transferred the disputed land in favour of opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 who are stranger purchasers. No notice of the transfer was served to the pre-emptors who are none but the brothers of opposite party No. 3 Harendia. The transfer was made by a kabala dated 7. 4. 69 for a sum of Tk. 1500/-. The pre-emptors came to know of the transfer on 5. 7. 69 and thereafter having made the necessary deposit, filed the application for pre-emption on 1. 8. 69.
